## LabelSheet

LabelSheet lays barcode labels out on a standard adhesive sheet, thirty to a
page, with the call number printed beneath each code.

## Reprint

A damaged label is reprinted from the copy record and keeps the same barcode
number, so open loans are unaffected.

## Numbering

Barcode numbers are issued in sequence and never reused.
